rules.rule: New async methods that do I/O take a CancellationToken and pass it to the calls they make.
Do not declare async void methods, except event handlers.
Do not call .Result or .Wait() on a Task.
Controller actions call a service; no DbContext queries in controllers.
Do not run two operations on the same DbContext at once with Task.WhenAll.
Do not build SQL by concatenating or interpolating strings into FromSqlRaw or ExecuteSqlRaw; use parameters.
Do not add connection strings, API keys or passwords as string literals.
